name: opening_lines
note: The start of the opinion, where recent CourtListener opinions have the caption and the panel (it is not kept in the table)

name: disposition_enforce
pattern: Order of the National Labor Relations Board enforced

name: docket_criminal
note: A criminal docket number ("06-CR-126", "4:07CR00123", or "Criminal Action No. 07-123")

name: docket_civil
note: A civil docket number ("08-cv-1478", "CIV. 05-1234", or "Civil Action No. 05-123")

name: party1_united_states
note: The United States itself as a party ("UNITED STATES OF AMERICA", "U.S.", or "USA", alone or as a relator's or user's plaintiff), not a company or official with "United States" in its name

name: party2_united_states
note: The United States itself as a party ("UNITED STATES OF AMERICA", "U.S.", or "USA", alone or as a relator's or user's plaintiff), not a company or official with "United States" in its name

name: panel_text
note: The panel as the opinion's opening names it: "Before SMITH, Chief Judge, and JONES and BROWN, Circuit Judges" (or "Present:"), with any judge or justice sitting by designation

name: panel_text
note: Otherwise, the source's list of judges (which may name only the author, or be blank)

name: panel_judges
note: Splits the panel into names at titles, filler words, and punctuation ("J", "JR", and "SR" are kept when a name follows them: a middle initial, or initials such as "S.R.")

name: authors
note: The author (no name for a per curiam opinion)

name: concurring
note: Judges who wrote or joined a concurrence

name: dissenting
note: Judges who wrote or joined a dissent
